name: 32807 · Orlando, FL
findings: ZIP 32807 (Orlando) has 80 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32807 (Orlando) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32807 (Orlando) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
